detailed_descriptions.en: Blend the endless freedom of a sandbox with the strategic depth of a Roguelite as you draft Olympian gods to nurture, conquer, or destroy living pixel civilizations. In this randomly generated sandbox, every human is a unique individual with their own name and traits. You can play as a passive observer, watching them work and grow naturally, or actively intervene. Use divine powers to create resources, boost the population, or grant technological revelations, guiding your people from scattered settlements into fortified city-states. Command eight Olympian deities, including Zeus, Hades, Apollo, and Ares. In each run, select three gods to form your unique divine council. Your choice defines how you intervene in the world: heal wounds and convert believers with Apollo’s melody, resurrect the dead with Hades’ power, or strike with Zeus’ thunderbolts. These diverse synergies form the strategic foundation of every playthrough. Faith is the vital link between god and mortal. Perform miracles to inspire the populace, converting them into loyal believers to generate "Faith." This resource is essential for unlocking and upgrading your divine abilities. Listen to prayers at your temples; answering these pleas allows you to activate powerful artifacts that grant global bonuses to your civilization. Growth invites conflict. Over time, heretic factions and hostile city-states will rise to compete for land and followers. How you deal with these threats is up to you: guide your faithful armies in a "Holy War" to conquer them, or simply use your divine wrath to smite their cities from the map, ensuring the purity of your faith. With nearly 200 skill combinations, experimenting with different deity rosters, upgrade paths, and artifact synergies will spawn diverse strategic playstyles. By collecting "Faith Crystals," you'll unlock permanent meta-progression—recruit new gods to your pantheon and learn devastating new abilities. Combined with procedurally generated massive maps and terrain challenges, every attempt to build a civilization offers a totally fresh run. Beyond the main progression, the game features rich expanded modes: dive into Sandbox Mode with all powers and artifacts unlocked to build your ultimate utopia, or trigger a cross-dimensional brawl, bringing major pantheons together for an entertaining, auto-battler-style god clash.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 這是一款快節奏的 Roguelite 上帝模擬器：挑選三位神明搭配出上百種神力 Combo，在隨機生成的像素沙盒中降下神蹟與神罰，體驗每一局都截然不同的文明擴張。 在隨機生成的沙盒世界中，每一個人類單位都擁有自己的名字和獨特的特質。你可以作為觀察者，看著他們自發地工作、繁衍；也可以主動介入，透過神力創造資源、增加人口或賜予科技啟示，引導文明從鬆散的聚落成長為堅固的城邦。 遊戲提供了宙斯、黑帝斯、阿波羅、阿瑞斯等八位奧林帕斯神祇供你調遣。每次開局，你需要從諸神中挑選三位組成獨特的創世陣容。不同的神明決定了你干預世界的方式：是用阿波羅的樂曲治癒傷口、轉化信徒，還是用黑帝斯的力量復活死者，亦或是藉宙斯之手降下雷霆。這些差異化的神力組合構成了每局遊戲策略流派的基礎。 「信仰」是連結神與人的核心資源。你需要施展神蹟來感化凡人，將其轉化為信徒並獲取「信仰值」，進而解鎖或強化更高級的神力。此外，你還需要在神廟中聆聽祈禱——完成信徒的請求後，可以選擇啟動一件神器，賦予文明更多增益效果。 文明的發展伴隨著競爭。隨著時間推移，異教徒勢力和敵對城邦將會出現，與你爭奪有限的土地和人口。面對威脅，你可以選擇代理人戰爭，引導你的信徒軍隊發動「聖戰」；也可以運用神力，直接降下神罰將異教徒的城市從地圖上徹底抹除，以保衛信仰的純潔性。 遊戲設計了近兩百種技能組合，不同的神祇搭配、神力升級路線以及神器的選擇，將衍生出多樣的策略流派。透過收集「信仰結晶」，你可以獲得局外的永久成長，不僅能解鎖新神明加入陣營，還能習得毀滅性的新技能。結合隨機生成的超大地圖和地形挑戰，每一次文明的推演都將是一次全新的嘗試。 主線之外，遊戲還提供了豐富的擴展玩法：在「沙盒模式」中解鎖全部神力與神器，隨心打造你的理想國度；或是開啟跨維度大亂鬥，讓各大神系齊聚一堂，享受「電子鬥蟲」（放置觀戰）的樂趣。
